### Start-of-Quarter Survey {.unnumbered}

Please fill out the anonymous [start-of-quarter survey](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeR4g368PE_HCeyF2IVcyVmSFBxhTfrTP69BX8ZCSfB6_R80A/viewform)
before class on Friday, January 8.
Every question is optional.
A few more optional questions need your name, so they are not on the form;
answer them in a Canvas message to me instead.

### Anonymous Feedback {.unnumbered}

Unlike the start-of-quarter survey,
the [anonymous feedback form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdGo-31iMGMyFMAMxgwGkPVa2mK4vK8lGEBN6fxCGwuZcfV-w/viewform)
stays open all quarter,
so you can use it at any time.
Tell me what is working, what is not,
and how I could improve the course.
I read every response.
